subject: Some help getting rid of the gridline background

messages.author: fca01f44f8b824c4
messages.subject: Some help getting rid of the gridline background
parts:
Hello,

I am having a little bit of trouble getting rid of the gridline background. I am using "theme_bw", but seems I am doing something wrong. Also, when using the code attaching some of the things work and other no if I ask for all of them. For instance, the labels are not changed if I place the "scale_colour_grey" first or the colour does not work if the code for labels is written first. Why is this happening?

The fake data attached can be used instead of my EstimateSECadults.txt

Thanks for any help you can provide.

Sincerely,

Paola

Ecadults<-read.table(file="/Users/paolabarriga/Desktop/EstimateSECadults.txt", header=T, sep="\t")

names(Ecadults)

str(Ecadults)

Ecadults$group

Ecadults$samples

Ecadults$data

Ecadults$lower

Ecadults$upper

"as.factor(group)"

Ec<-ggplot(data=Ecadults, aes(x=samples, y=data, group=group, colour=group))+geom_line()+geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(x= samples, ymin=data-lower,ymax=data+upper), width=0.01)

Ec+labs(x="sample number",y="species number")

Ec+ scale_colour_grey() +theme_bw #this produces error message saying: "Error: Don't know how to add theme_bw to a plot"

On 10/13/2011 2:24 PM, Paola Barriga wrote:
> Hello,
>
> I am having a little bit of trouble getting rid of the gridline background.
> I am using "theme_bw", but seems I am doing something wrong. Also, when
> using the code attaching some of the things work and other no if I ask for
> all of them. For instance, the labels are not changed if I place the
> "scale_colour_grey" first or the colour does not work if the code for labels
> is written first. Why is this happening?

Do you mean that you get different results for:

Ec + scale_colour_grey() + labs(x="sample number", y="species number")

and

Ec + labs(x="sample number", y="species number") + scale_colour_grey()

?

Otherwise, is it that you are running those two commands (below) and are
only seeing the effects of the last one? If that is the case, that is
expected; each one is adding one thing to the base plot (Ec) and showing
that. If you want to add consecutively, you must resave in Ec:

Ec <- Ec + ...

> The fake data attached can be used instead of my EstimateSECadults.txt
>
> Thanks for any help you can provide.
>
> Sincerely,
>
> Paola

> "/Users/paolabarriga/Desktop/EstimateSECadults.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
>
> names(Ecadults)
>

>
> Ecadults$group

>

> ))+geom_line()+geom_point()+geom_errorbar(aes(x= samples, ymin=data-lower,
> ymax=data+upper), width=0.01)

>
> Ec+ scale_colour_grey() +theme_bw #this produces error message saying:
> "Error: Don't know how to add theme_bw to a plot"

Here this should be theme_bw() theme_bw() is a function that returns a
theme, not a theme by itself.
